```python
import sys
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def f(x, nd=2):
    return round(float(x), nd)


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
        if value is None or (isinstance(value, float) and not np.isfinite(value)):
            return
        facts.append({
            "entity": entity,
            "metric": metric,
            "period": period,
            "value": float(value),
            "formula": formula,
        })

    # ---- Totals ----
    rev_tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_ly = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True)
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", f(rev_tw), "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", f(rev_lw), "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    if df["Revenue_LY"].notna().any():
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", f(rev_ly), "sum(Revenue_LY)")
    if rev_lw and rev_lw != 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", f((rev_tw - rev_lw) / rev_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")
    if df["Revenue_LY"].notna().any() and rev_ly:
        sub = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_LY"])
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY",
            f((sub["Revenue_TW"].sum() - sub["Revenue_LY"].sum()) / sub["Revenue_LY"].sum() * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100 over rows with LY data")

    u_tw = df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    u_lw = df["Units_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    o_tw = df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    o_lw = df["Orders_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", f(u_tw), "sum(Units_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "units", "WoW", f((u_tw - u_lw) / u_lw * 100, 1) if u_lw else None,
        "(sum(Units_TW) - sum(Units_LW)) / sum(Units_LW) * 100")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", f(o_tw), "sum(Orders_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "WoW", f((o_tw - o_lw) / o_lw * 100, 1) if o_lw else None,
        "(sum(Orders_TW) - sum(Orders_LW)) / sum(Orders_LW) * 100")

    # ---- Top entities by revenue ----
    top = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW"]).sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False)
    for _, r in top.head(3).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", f(r["Revenue_TW"]), "Revenue_TW for this entity")
        share = r["Share_Pct"] if pd.notna(r["Share_Pct"]) else (
            r["Revenue_TW"] / rev_tw * 100 if rev_tw else np.nan)
        add(r["Entity"], "share", "TW", f(share, 1), "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")
        add(r["Entity"], "rank", "TW", f(r["Rank"], 0), "rank by Revenue_TW (1 = highest)")

    # Top-3 concentration
    if len(top) >= 3 and rev_tw:
        add("TOTAL", "share", "TW", f(top.head(3)["Revenue_TW"].sum() / rev_tw * 100, 1),
            "sum(top 3 Revenue_TW) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")

    # ---- WoW movers (percent) ----
    w = df.dropna(subset=["WoW_Pct"]).sort_values("WoW_Pct", ascending=False)
    for _, r in w.head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", f(r["WoW_Pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")
    for _, r in w.tail(2).iloc[::-1].iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", f(r["WoW_Pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")

    # ---- WoW movers (absolute GBP) ----
    a = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW"]).copy()
    if not a.empty:
        a["delta"] = a["Revenue_TW"] - a["Revenue_LW"]
        a = a.sort_values("delta", ascending=False)
        top_d = a.iloc[0]
        add(top_d["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", f(top_d["delta"]),
            "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW (largest absolute gain)")
        bot_d = a.iloc[-1]
        if bot_d["Entity"] != top_d["Entity"]:
            add(bot_d["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", f(bot_d["delta"]),
                "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW (largest absolute decline)")

    # ---- YoY movers ----
    y = df.dropna(subset=["YoY_Pct"]).sort_values("YoY_Pct", ascending=False)
    for _, r in y.head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", f(r["YoY_Pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")
    for _, r in y.tail(1).iterrows():
        if r["Entity"] not in [x["entity"] for x in facts if x["period"] == "YoY"]:
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", f(r["YoY_Pct"], 1),
                "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")

    # ---- Units / orders leaders ----
    if df["Units_TW"].notna().any():
        ru = df.sort_values("Units_TW", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(ru["Entity"], "units", "TW", f(ru["Units_TW"], 0), "max(Units_TW) across entities")
    if df["Orders_TW"].notna().any():
        ro = df.sort_values("Orders_TW", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(ro["Entity"], "orders", "TW", f(ro["Orders_TW"], 0), "max(Orders_TW) across entities")

    print(json.dumps(facts[:25]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
